section_summary: This section documents U.S. State Department and SCAP records from May to November 1949 concerning the implementation, progress, and political prospects of Japan's post-World War II agrarian and agricultural reforms. It includes policy directives from the Far Eastern Commission, reports and press releases on land tenure transfer, democratic agricultural cooperatives, and crop insurance, discussions assessing potential Japanese political resistance to the reforms, and notices to Japanese-American landowners published in the Nichi Bei Times. It also contains a major SCAP Natural Resources Section publication reviewing agricultural statistics, fertilizers, pest control, seed supplies, livestock, storage, and land reclamation.

subfiles.about: A directive transmitting the Far Eastern Commission's agrarian reform policy of April 28, 1949, to SCAP for guidance.
subfiles.from: State, Army, Navy, and Air Force Departments
subfiles.summary: Transmits Far Eastern Commission policy endorsing SCAP directives and Japanese legislation that eliminated exorbitant rents in kind and established owner-farmers, directing continued application of these principles.
subfiles.title: Directive to the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers: Agrarian Reform in Japan (Serial No. 103)
subfiles.to: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers

subfiles.about: An office memorandum submitting a draft transmittal memorandum to the Secretary General of the Far Eastern Commission.
subfiles.from: Niles W. Bond (Office of Northeast Asian Affairs, NA)
subfiles.summary: Submits a draft memorandum transmitting a certified copy of SCAP Directive Serial No. 103 to the Far Eastern Commission.
subfiles.title: Office Memorandum: Directive to SCAP regarding Agrarian Reform in Japan
subfiles.to: W. Walton Butterworth (Director, Office of Far Eastern Affairs)

subfiles.about: An official memorandum transmitting a certified copy of Directive Serial No. 103 to the Far Eastern Commission.
subfiles.from: W. Walton Butterworth (Director, Office of Far Eastern Affairs)
subfiles.summary: Transmits a certified copy of Directive Serial No. 103 regarding Japanese agrarian reform to the Far Eastern Commission.
subfiles.title: Memorandum for the Secretary General, Far Eastern Commission: Certified Copy of Directive Serial No. 103
subfiles.to: Nelson T. Johnson (Secretary General, Far Eastern Commission)

subfiles.about: A diplomatic despatch transmitting SCAP Natural Resources Section publications and press releases on Japanese agricultural reforms.
subfiles.from: U.S. Political Adviser for Japan, Tokyo (Chargé d'Affaires ad interim)
subfiles.summary: Transmits SCAP Natural Resources Section publications detailing land reform, agricultural cooperatives, and crop and livestock insurance, highlighting tenancy reduction, cooperative democratization, and risk-adjusted insurance.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 405: Headquarters Publications on Agricultural Reform

subfiles.about: A public information bulletin detailing the administration, achievements, and legal basis of Japan's land reform program.
subfiles.from: Public Information Office, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Describes Japan's land reform program, its administration by elected local land commissions, acquisition of 4.5 million cultivated acres for resale to farmers, and provisions protecting remaining tenant farmers.
subfiles.title: Information Bulletin: Land Reform Program in Japan

subfiles.about: A public information bulletin reviewing the reorganization of agricultural associations into democratic, farmer-controlled cooperatives.
subfiles.from: Public Information Office, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Details the dissolution of wartime government-controlled agricultural associations and the establishment of over 31,000 democratic, farmer-controlled cooperatives and federations under Law 132 to serve member farming households.
subfiles.title: Information Bulletin No. 4: The Agricultural Cooperative Program

subfiles.about: A Natural Resources Section report reviewing the history, reforms, and provisions of Japan's crop and livestock insurance program.
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Explains the Compensation Against Agricultural Loss Law of 1947, which established unified, area-specific risk-based insurance premiums, compulsory coverage for staple crops subsidized by the government, and voluntary livestock insurance.
subfiles.title: Report: Crop and Livestock Insurance in Japan

subfiles.about: A Department of State summary memorandum reviewing Tokyo Despatch No. 405 and its enclosed reports on agricultural reform.
subfiles.from: J. L. Stegmaier (Office of Northeast Asian Affairs, FE:NA)
subfiles.summary: Summarizes Tokyo Despatch No. 405 and enclosed SCAP releases regarding land reform, agricultural cooperatives, and restructured crop insurance.
subfiles.title: Memorandum: Summary of Tokyo Despatch No. 405

subfiles.about: A memorandum forwarding SCAP literature on Japanese cooperatives to the Department of State for transmission to the UN/FAO.
subfiles.from: Lt. Col. E. W. Hendrick (Acting Chief, Far Eastern Affairs Group, Office of the Under Secretary of the Army)
subfiles.summary: Forwards SCAP reports on Japanese agricultural cooperatives to the State Department for transmission to the UN Food and Agriculture Organization.
subfiles.title: Memorandum: Report on Japanese Cooperatives for UN/FAO
subfiles.to: Mrs. V. H. Duffus (Office of United Nations Affairs, UNA, Department of State)

subfiles.about: A diplomatic note transmitting SCAP reports on the Japanese agricultural cooperative program to the FAO.
subfiles.summary: Transmits SCAP reports on Japan's agricultural cooperative program to the Director General of the Food and Agriculture Organization.
subfiles.title: Diplomatic Note to the Director General of the Food and Agriculture Organization: Reports on the Agricultural Cooperative Program in Japan
subfiles.to: Director General of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

subfiles.about: A memorandum of conversation recording Laurence Hewes' assessment that Japanese conservative leadership might sabotage agrarian reforms.
subfiles.from: Laurence Hewes, Marshall Green, and Robert A. Fearey
subfiles.summary: Records Laurence Hewes' warnings that the Yoshida Government was attempting to sabotage agrarian reforms by underfunding land registration, appointing opponent Kotaro Mori, and altering land commissions, recommending peace treaty safeguards.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation: Japanese Agrarian Reform

subfiles.about: A cover letter informing the State Department that notices concerning Japanese land reform sales were printed in the Nichi Bei Times.
subfiles.from: Y. W. Abiko (Editor, The Nichi Bei Times)
subfiles.summary: Informs the Secretary of State that land reform notices were published for Japanese-American residents, enclosing a copy of the newspaper.
subfiles.title: Letter from Y. W. Abiko to the Secretary of State: Japanese Land Reform Notices

subfiles.about: A newspaper clipping reporting on Japanese land reform notices affecting Japanese Americans, alongside community and general news.
subfiles.summary: Reports on Japanese land reform sales affecting Japanese-American landowners, alongside stories on the Provoo treason trial, Harvard Law Review editor Sho Sato, and community events.
subfiles.title: Newspaper Clipping: The Nichi Bei Times (Land Reform Notices and General News)

subfiles.about: An official letter thanking the editor of the Nichi Bei Times for publishing notices regarding Japanese land reform sales.
subfiles.from: John M. Allison (Director, Office of Northeast Asian Affairs)
subfiles.summary: Expresses appreciation to Y. W. Abiko for publishing Japanese land reform sale notices in the Nichi Bei Times.
subfiles.title: Letter from John M. Allison to Y. W. Abiko: Acknowledgment of Land Reform Notices
subfiles.to: Y. W. Abiko (Editor, The Nichi Bei Times)

subfiles.about: A diplomatic despatch transmitting a comprehensive SCAP Natural Resources Section publication on Japanese agricultural programs under the Occupation.
subfiles.from: Acting U.S. Political Adviser for Japan, Tokyo (Carl H. Boehringer)
subfiles.summary: Transmits copies of a comprehensive SCAP Natural Resources Section publication reviewing Japanese agricultural programs under the Occupation.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 798: Transmission of Publication on Japanese Agricultural Programs Under the Occupation

subfiles.about: A comprehensive SCAP Natural Resources Section report analyzing production statistics, technical agricultural inputs, livestock, storage, and land development in postwar Japan.
subfiles.from: Agriculture Division, Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: This report presents detailed analyses of Japan's agricultural situation and Occupation-sponsored agricultural rehabilitation programs. It covers agricultural production statistics showing recovery toward prewar staple crop yields, domestic fertilizer production and allocation improvements, and modern chemical pest and disease control methods. It further evaluates seed breeding and foundation farms, the role of livestock and national breeding stations, sweet potato and grain storage initiatives, and long-range land reclamation and irrigation projects.
subfiles.title: Japanese Agriculture Programs Under the Occupation: Discussion of Programs
